user_preference: When a species has both a custom Mega design and Gigantamax art, prefer the custom Mega. Do not repurpose Gigantamax art as the Mega merely because it is official.
rules: Custom Mega beats Gigantamax when choosing Mercury's Mega design.
Gigantamax art may remain in the library as a canon reference/form asset, but it is not a substitute for a distinct Mega.
If multiple custom Mega designs exist for the same species, keep them grouped for side-by-side approval rather than silently choosing one.
Official Mega forms still take precedence over fan/custom Mega interpretations when the Mega itself is canon.
approval_sheet_behavior: These species will show the custom Mega candidate(s) in the Mega approval pool. G-Max versions will not be presented as Mega replacements.
